title: Lattice Mass Gaps and Continuum Criteria for Four-Dimensional Yang-Mills Theory
description: We prove strong-coupling lattice mass gaps for compact simple gauge groups and a conditional transfer from a physical-scale cube estimate. An integrated response criterion controls spatial covariance row sums without a uniform relaxation gap. The required weak-coupling Wilson bounds and nontrivial four-dimensional continuum construction remain open.
